PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Results-driven investment operations and securities valuation professional with 8+ years of experience, including 
5+ years at State Street, one of the world's leading custodian banks. Sole Point of Contact (SPOC) for 2 major 
institutional clients, managing end-to-end securities operations across 500+ daily securities exceptions,  ensuring zero 
SLA breaches and full  compliance with audit controls.  Deep expertise in securities pricing, portfolio valuation,  NAV 
calculation, corporate actions, and OTC derivatives across multi -asset portfolios. Adept at leveraging 
Bloomberg, ICE, Reuters, and JPM systems to drive data accuracy, reduce exception resolution time, and deliver 
operational excellence. MBA -Finance graduate with strong cross -functional collaboration and stakeholder 
communication skills. 
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS 
• Designated SPOC for 2 major institutional clients at State Street, managing full lifecycle of investment 
operations and serving as the primary escalation point for all client queries and exceptions. 
• Resolved 500+ daily securities exceptions across multi-asset portfolios, maintaining 1 00% SLA adherence 
and zero critical escalations through proactive root cause analysis and vendor coordination. 
• Reduced pricing exception resolution time by 20% by optimising cross-vendor workflows across Bloomberg, 
ICE, and Reuters through systematic process improvements and proactive broker outreach. 
• Contributed to process automation initiatives that reduced manual operational effort by an estimated 30%, 
improving team throughput and reporting accuracy across fund accounting workflows. 
• Trained and onboarded multiple new team members on securities operations, fund accounting procedures, 
and audit controls — ensuring consistent service quality and knowledge continuity.
